summary: A compact, visual dramatic beat with a clean turn: Sayed names the tactical impossibility, and Shalabi converts the same image into the solution. Both lines are natural, playable and restrained under real operational pressure.

lines.speaker: SAYED

performance.delivery: Still prone beside Shalabi, Sayed scans the exposed ground as he speaks. Keep it gravelly and practical; the complaint is really a warning about the men.

lines.text: نِسْتَخَبَّى فِينْ هِنَا يَا فَنْدِمْ؟ دِي مَفْرُودَةْ زَيّْ السِّجَّادَةْ.

performance.emotion: controlled resolve as the solution crystallizes
performance.delivery: Shalabi watches the sand run through his fingers, then answers Sayed without looking up. Let a tiny pause carry the instant in which the metaphor becomes a tactical decision.
